title: Control Plane Utilities
author: theasianpianist
body:
Methods to verify ToR database states:

1. Verify APP_DB matches expected state for dual ToR related values
2. Verify STATE_DB matches expected state for dual ToR related values

Depends on #2754

linkedPullRequests.title: [dual_tor] Add control plane utility functions
linkedPullRequests.author: lolyu
